query: How do I find documents in the knowledge base?
response: To find documents in the Northstar Technologies knowledge base, you can use the Research Agent with the "Knowledge base search" capability. This feature allows you to retrieve and summarize documents from Northstar's internal knowledge base. Simply provide the Research Agent with the name or topic of the document you are looking for, and it will return the summary if available. If you need further assistance or the document summary is not sufficient, please contact the AI Enablement team at ai-team@northstar-tech.com.
